scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.js && pnpm run test:python:unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:db:create && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.js && pnpm run test:python:integration && pnpm run test:db:destroy
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:db:create && playwright test && pnpm run test:db:destroy
scripts.test:python:unit: cd packages/learning-engine-service && poetry run pytest tests/unit/ && cd ../question-generation-service && poetry run pytest tests/unit/
scripts.test:python:integration: cd packages/learning-engine-service && poetry run pytest tests/integration/ && cd ../question-generation-service && poetry run pytest tests/integration/
scripts.test:db:create: cd infrastructure/docker && ENVIRONMENT=test NODE_ENV=test docker-compose up -d postgres redis && sleep 10 && cd ../../packages/migration-service && NODE_ENV=test pnpm run migrate:latest
